title: agrostis novae-hollandiae
intro: Agrostis novae-hollandiae, commonly known as New Holland Bentgrass, is a type of grass species native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its ability to soothe coughs and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis novae-hollandiae include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and the specific bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties.
